properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Two real transitive dependencies: secp256k1@^4.0.2 (ECDSA signing + recovery on the secp256k1 curve, via @solana/web3.js) in the close-account client, and @noble/secp256k1@^1.6.3 in the root project. The build ships secp256k1 ECDSA; the blockchain curve is fixed by the Solana/secp256k1 ecosystem, so replacement (ML-DSA) is a platform-level migration, changeable only with the chain itself.

properties.name: pqs:context

No application runtime call site; presence-only. Changeable here (swap the docs dev-server HTTPS story or drop the dev dependency).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Ed25519 signature support ships in the docs/examples dependency tree: ed25519-hd-key ^1.2.0 is a DIRECT dependency (package.json:20) live at tour/create-keypair/bip44.ts:10, and @noble/ed25519 ^1.7.0 is transitive via @metaplex/js. The live signing engine for Solana transactions is tweetnacl via @solana/web3.js (separate object); this entry records the primitive's presence in the declared dependency inventory. Changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: These six stub pages (en + zh) document Solana durable nonces — an on-chain Hash value stored in a nonce account and used as the recentBlockhash substitute for replay protection. The nonce is public chain data, not secret material, and the stubs themselves embed no material; the implementing samples are advanced/durable-nonce/{create-nonce-account,query-nonce,use-nonce}/main.en.ts, which use web3.js NonceAccount/SystemProgram.nonce* APIs. Kept as documentation of a replay-protection (posture) me
